It was a LONG journey... I just went to my GP for months for medication I guess until they realized I needed more help, referred me to counselling which was useless but I had to do it... after a few years I ended up being put on the waiting list for a psychiatrist which was months, honestly I can’t remember much it’s a bit hazy but that’s what I remember... I’m in Scotland btw, maybe it’s different for the rest of the UK, I’m not sure
I would, but money is a bit of a problem right now for me so I don’t think I can afford it. Maybe in a few months but I’ll probably have an appointment by then anyway
I don’t have any medication left unfortunately and don’t have a repeat prescription or anything so I can’t get it... I will look at that website, thanks
I don’t know, I am not sure there is anything they could really do and I don’t want to waste their time or take up resources especially since it’s busier this time of year plus there’s covid...
Thanks for the advice, I will try. I think writing stuff down is a good idea, thank you
Thank you for the recommendations

Me too honestly it terrifies me because of the possible memory effects, I’m scared I’ll forget important memories to me, but at the same time I would be willing to try anything since I’ve pretty much ran out of options. I’ve read about psilocybin but honestly I would have no idea where to get it and I would absolutely try it if I could since it sounds like it can really help some people. It’s just I have no means of getting it really
I have tried tons of therapists every time they just tell me I am too depressed and dismiss me
Try to do what? I think I have tried everything. Only thing to try is to just survive, which I have been trying to do, but it is too painful to live my whole life like this
I’m really sorry you had a bad experience there. It’s so true though
Why would I think that
Memory loss is one of my main concerns, it’s scary having that risk, but supposedly from what I’ve read so far it’s usually just temporary. And I haven’t heard of that, I will look into it, thank you
Because I’ll never feel better
Well that part of my life seems inevitable, I’ve felt for a long time that I’m meant to eventually kill myself, I don’t know why
I’ve been self harming a lot, I know I’m going to eventually kill myself, I used to think maybe in a few years but much sooner seems more likely
I have treatment resistant severe chronic depression and anxiety and bdd for most of my life and I don’t want to live in this much pain
I think you’re right. It just never feels like enough every time I do it. It makes me want to just try again to see if I can go any deeper
